[[Company Brain]] › Reference › CLI commands

== adk ==

From [[Company Brain/awdk|awdk]].

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Command
! What it does
|-
| <code>adk quickstart</code>
| Detects hardware, pulls models, configures backends
|-
| <code>adk init NAME</code>
| Scaffolds an agent project
|-
| <code>adk home serve [--channels ...] [--pair]</code>
| Answers you on Telegram, Discord, Slack, email, WhatsApp, SMS; <code>--pair</code> prints a 6-digit code to DM the bot
|-
| <code>adk home channels</code>
| Shows which channels have credentials in the environment
|-
| <code>adk mcp setup --mode remote --ide claude-code</code>
| Writes an MCP client config
|-
| <code>adk harness parts</code>
| Reports which family parts this machine has, and the install line for each missing one
|}

== awbrain ==

From [[Company Brain/awbrain|awbrain]].

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Command
! What it does
|-
| <code>awbrain harvest DIR</code>
| Builds or refreshes the wiki from a folder of notes/sessions
|-
| <code>awbrain ask &quot;QUESTION&quot;</code>
| Answers from the top-k pages only, with <code><nowiki>[[citation]]</nowiki></code> markers
|-
| <code>awbrain verify &quot;CLAIM&quot;</code>
| Walks a claim back to the source file and line span, or says it cannot
|-
| <code>awbrain watch DIR</code>
| Re-harvests changed sources
|-
| <code>awbrain status</code>
| Receipts: sources, pages, claims, embedder mode
|}

== awdiscord ==

Setup and administration commands (chat commands are on the [[Company Brain/Discord command reference|Discord command reference]]).

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Command
! What it does
|-
| <code>awdiscord setup</code>
| Validates the token, finds a model server, writes config, registers commands, prints the install link
|-
| <code>awdiscord run [--inbox-port N]</code>
| Runs the bot; the port opens <code>GET /health</code>
|-
| <code>awdiscord approval TITLE BODY --callback URL</code>
| Raises an [[Company Brain/Approvals|approval card]]
|-
| <code>awdiscord new-plugin NAME</code>
| Scaffolds a plugin
|-
| <code>awdiscord plugins</code>
| Proves plugins load
|-
| <code>awdiscord pack install\|list\|remove</code>
| Manage [[Company Brain/Plugins and packs|packs]]
|}
